label: wol
description: Sends a Wake-on-LAN magic packet. Payload is a dict with the target's MAC address; an ip entry sets the destination (default: broadcast).

properties.name: port
properties.label: port
properties.help: Destination UDP port. 9 is the Wake-on-LAN default; some machines listen on 7.

properties.name: repeats
properties.label: repeats
properties.help: How many times to send the packet. Broadcasts can be dropped; 3 is a common choice.
